fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in the cars by owner section.
findings: Silver paint on hood, doors and rear hatch looks clean and glossy in the photos
Black lower cladding and rear bumper trim look dark, not faded
Headlight lenses look clear in the front shots
A few light marks on the lower front bumper and the side sills, hard to judge in the low sun
No clear interior photos, so the cabin can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2018 CR-V. It already looks clean and glossy in the photos, and a wash and wax plus an interior wipe-down would keep it looking that sharp for buyers. We're a local detailer and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
